name: Amanda E.
text: Paige was awesome in helping my boyfriend and me find somewhere to live. She listened to our needs and did everything she could to make sure they were met.

name: Lx
text: I worked with Jeff A., he made the experience painless, he provided great options based on what I told him I was looking for. Very efficient, and anytime I emailed questions or concerns he responded in a timely manner. I would work with Jeff again and I would recommend him. Thanks Jeff!

name: Jordyn S.
text: After many failed attempts at moving the last two years, I finally decided to look into help from an apartment locator. I worked with 4 people from different companies this time around, and Sydney at Apartment Agents was by far the best! I’m a very particular person when it comes to where I live, and Sydney was very understanding and worked tirelessly to help find my dream apartment. She sent me a list of available units with all the specs, and even set up tours for me to attend. She also followed up after the tour so I could give her feedback. After just 2 weeks of searching I signed a lease for an apartment that had pretty much all of my wants & needs for an amazing price! I’d probably be signing another terrible lease at my current apartment if it wasn’t for Sydney! Everything was at no cost to me; I even got a rebate! I would recommend Apartment Agents (specifically Sydney Jepson) to everyone I know looking for a new place!

name: Ally C.
text: I’m moving cross country to Texas. I was getting so distraught and nervous because I didn’t know what location I should move to and I couldn’t find an apartment that fit all my needs. I found Alex and his company on google and after 30 minutes from contacting him, he found me the perfect location and place. I move in on July 30th and I’m so excited. Before you exhaust yourself with endless searches, I recommend 100% you contact Alex first!

name: Sam Z.
text: No money? No problem! A friend of mine recommended this service to me when I said I was moving into town, and this made it incredibly easy to find a quality apartment and move in without any hassle. I would recommend SIX stars if I could! Thank you Ms. Cindy!

name: Isaac Z.
text: Sydney was the apartment realtor who helped me relocate to Dallas. She was extremely helpful in locating an apartment that best fit my requirements. I am honestly more than satisfied with the choice she provided as my new apartment. I would definitely recommend Apartment Agents for their services and their realtors like Sydney!

name: Annie B.
text: When I found out I had to find a place to move on such short notice (2 weeks!) I was overwhelmed that I would never be able to find something that worked for me. I needed private garage parking and a yard and it’s nearly impossible to sort through apartment websites looking for those “must-haves”. I did not think it was possible to find everything I wanted in one place but Paige reached out to me and made it happen! She worked hard to find me multiple options and I settled on a place that she found that was brand new, had everything I wanted (and more!), great move-in specials, and most importantly, felt like home. I was able to move-in just 4 days after viewing the property, which much exceeded my expectations and goals. I could not have done it without Paige! I highly recommend her for helping you find your dream apartment!

name: Trey M.
text: Paige Prestwood is absolutely amazing. I started a search over a year ago and then decided to stay put. She not only kept in touch with me, but was extremely professional and ultimately found me the perfect place well within my budget. Thanks so much Paige! I’ll be sending friends and family your way.

name: Blaine S.
text: Paige is incredible. Trust me when I tell you she is the one you want to work with. Went above and beyond to find me the perfect place. If you do only one thing, ask for Paige. She rocks.

name: Jessica S.
text: I have used Shannon with Apartment Agents now twice to find my perfect home. She’s delivered in spades both times and I cannot more highly recommend her and Apartment Agents as a whole.

name: J. S.
text: I've been using Shannon as my apartment locator for the past 4 years and she's nothing short of amazing. Always willing to make adjustments for different areas I've been interested in moving to and catering to my requests for the list of amenities and interior requests. I also never have to wait around for an updated list because she's on top of everything and knows the DFW like the back of her hand. If you're looking for a new home definitely reach out to her. As long as I'm living in apartments, she's my go-to without hesitation!

name: Ros M.
text: Kristina was an amazing agent – she was kind, attentive, listened to my needs and wants, and was able to provide me with several amazing options within my requested price range. She scheduled everything and made the entire process unbelievably easy, and I was able to find and sign a lease at a great apartment within a week of reaching out to Kristina! I definitely recommend using Apartment Agents to find a new lease! 10/10

name: Dina D.
text: Shannon was great in helping my colleagues and I find accommodation in Dallas. We told her what we were looking for, size, location, amenities, and she very quickly sent us a list of places within our budget and helped set up viewings. Moving to a new place can be very difficult and stressful. Shannon helped ease that stress for us, and we all ended up in a fantastic apartment complex that more than fulfilled all our wish list.

name: Carline U.
text: Cindy from Apartment Agents was amazing, quick responses and provided a comprehensive list that allowed me to narrow down my options. It is now week 3 in my apartment and I love it more each day. Thanks again, Cindy!

name: John G.
text: I have used this apartment locator service 2x in a row. Kristina C. is so helpful and flexible. I’m very picky with where I live and Kristina definitely catered to that. She helped me look through several apartments across the metroplex and find the right one. I’d recommend her services to anyone looking. She is very communicative and goal‑oriented. Thanks for all your help Kristina!

name: Troy H.
text: Apartment Agents (and Cindy Little in particular) were GREAT to work with, and found me a new apartment (and exactly what I wanted!) that SAME DAY. I sent her a list of “must haves” for accommodations and areas and prices, and I had several choices in my inbox very quickly. And her first choice for me, after hearing all my picky demands, was the one I ended up choosing after looking at like 5 others. I would highly recommend Cindy and WILL be using her again if the need arises.

name: Frances F.
text: I’ve been using Sara Dahlen for a couple of years now for my apartment finding needs and she is amazing!! All you have to do is tell her what you’re looking for and she does all the rest. She will find perfect matches all the way up to booking tours for you. Not only does she have a strong work ethic, she is such a joy to get to work with. I highly recommend using Sara for your next move!

name: Deja T.
text: Shannon was great. She found my dream apartment! Definitely would recommend her to anyone looking to rent in the DFW.

name: Kat P.
text: I had the pleasure of having Kristina helping me with my apartment search. She has been wonderful. She would always respond to my emails within a few minutes and went above and beyond to accommodate my criteria. She would even follow up on properties that matched exactly what I wanted but did not have any availability just to make sure that we did not miss an opportunity. Finding a decent apartment that doesn't cost $2,000 for a tiny studio in Dallas area is close to impossible and the search can be very frustrating but having someone like Kristina on your side is a tremendous help and it increases your chances of success.

name: Eric L.
text: If you need to find an apartment in the Metroplex, Apartment Agents is your best way to locate what you need. I have used their services 3 times. I cannot say enough good about Cindy and the team. Very professional and saved me a lot of time.

name: Callie D.
text: Apartment Agents is AMAZING!!! My boyfriend and I had gone to look at apartments on our own 4–5 times. We thought we had exhausted all our options, until we found Apartment Agents! Cindy Little was our agent, and she was super helpful, professional, quick at responding to text messages and emails, and just a HUGE HELP! I told her where we wanted to be and the things we wanted in an apartment, and she sent me a personalized list of apartments that checked all the boxes I wanted. I wouldn’t have found a place to live if it wasn’t for Cindy’s help! I can’t say enough great things about Cindy and Apartment Agents :)

name: Michael C.
text: I cannot thank Jeff enough for his help in finding an apartment. I gave him the challenge of finding a 3‑month lease that balances the needs of two work locations, and his work was INCREDIBLE. He was extremely responsive to my feedback, and was able to quickly narrow down which option would be the best fit for me. Loving the apartment he found for me!

name: Adolph E.
text: It's important to note that for 3 weeks prior to being told about Apartment Agents, and specifically Cindy, I was “working” with another locator agency that truly required me to place more calls to them than they to me. It only took Cindy what felt like a matter of minutes to return a list of apartments to me that were directly aligned to my requirements (location, size, price). With Cindy's help, within a week I had seen 3 places and made a decision for one of them. Being in the sales business for so long I know that customer experience is what drives loyalty and Cindy has made sure my experience will drive loyalty for a long time to come. It will be my pleasure to pass on her contact information to anyone I know or hear in passing that is looking for a place in/around DFW area. Cindy is most definitely an expert in her field and it was a memorable experience working with her.
